svg.title: Figure 4 | Combining workflows and an agent
svg.desc: Arrows show ordered handoffs: fixed entry checks → authorized exploration → fixed acceptance and human review. The internal agent loop is omitted; failed tests or review do not lead to production publication.

g.font-family: Arial, Noto Sans CJK TC, sans-serif
g.text: Figure 4 | Combining workflows and an agent
Check permissions, requirements and allowed scope.
Explore the problem, change code and run tests within authorization
Run fixed acceptance tests, record results and await human review.
Arrows show ordered handoffs: fixed entry checks → authorized
exploration → fixed acceptance and human review. The internal agent
loop is omitted; failed tests or review do not lead to production
